value.rationale: Complete sharp classification of finite-horizon frame tightness for a natural smallest nonnormal semigroup, unique globally condition-optimal generator for arbitrary complex directions, exact frame bounds and threshold b>2a. A clear unexpected effect is that extending the observation interval after the critical horizon strictly worsens optimal condition number even though each fixed-generator Gramian increases in PSD order. This precise parameter dependence is a useful design fact and not merely a routine sign check.
